# HyFlow Massage LLC

> Licensed massage therapy studio in Mountain View, California, specializing in manual lymphatic drainage (including post-surgical lymphatic drainage), therapeutic and deep tissue massage, and mobile in-home massage across the San Francisco Bay Area (within 37 miles of Mountain View).

- Address: 257 Castro St, Suite 214, Mountain View, CA 94041 (2nd floor, by appointment only)
- Phone / text: (408) 668-6562 · Email: booking@hyflowmassage.com
- Hours: open daily 9 AM – 9 PM
- Online booking: https://app.squareup.com/appointments/book/5xww3j31p4meck/LFR1TX70W4FF0/start
- Owner and lead therapist: Tina Zhang — California Certified Massage Therapist (CMT); manual lymphatic drainage (Vodder method) certified through Klose Training
- Languages: English, Mandarin Chinese, Russian
- Team: Tina Zhang (owner and lead therapist) and California-licensed female and male therapists; clients may request a female or male therapist
- Payment: credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, cash; HSA/FSA accepted (usually with a Letter of Medical Necessity); superbills for out-of-network insurance on request
- Cancellation: 24 hours' notice; late cancellations may be charged 50%, no-shows in full

## Core focus

1. Lymphatic drainage massage — wellness MLD and post-operative MLD after BBL, liposuction / Lipo 360, tummy tuck, mommy makeover, breast surgery, facelift, C-section and orthopedic surgery (written physician clearance required for post-op clients).
2. Therapeutic and deep tissue massage — chronic pain, neck and back tension, tech neck, sciatica-type pain.
3. Mobile massage — in-home, hotel and office visits focused on lymphatic drainage, deep tissue, Swedish massage and the Mother & Baby Bonding Package.

## In-studio prices (Mountain View)

- Manual Lymphatic Drainage; Prenatal & Postpartum; Deep Tissue; Therapeutic; Sports; Lomi Lomi; Swedish: $150 / 60 min, $230 / 90 min, $300 / 120 min
- Post-Op Lymphatic Drainage: $250 / 60 min, $375 / 90 min, $500 / 120 min (15-session and 20-session post-op packages available)
- Lymphatic Drainage + Compression Therapy; Lymphatic Drainage + Red Light Therapy: $200 / 60 min, $300 / 90 min, $400 / 120 min
- Mother & Baby Bonding Package (120 min: mom 90 min postpartum massage or lymphatic drainage + 30 min gentle, therapist-guided infant massage): $300 in studio; $400 at home (travel included within about 37 miles of Mountain View; +$50 / +$80 per therapist per visit in extended areas)
- In-studio packages: 600 min (10 hours) $1,250; 1,200 min (20 hours) $2,200
- Add-ons (+$30 each): LymphFlow Pro pneumatic compression, hot stone, rapid tension relief, aromatherapy, cupping

## Mobile massage prices

Mobile travel: included within about 37 miles of the studio (San Francisco to San Jose, Santa Cruz and Morgan Hill). Extended areas within about 2 hours: +$50 per therapist per visit for 37–62 miles (Oakland, Berkeley, Walnut Creek, Pleasanton, Dublin, Livermore, Half Moon Bay, Pacifica, Gilroy) and +$80 per therapist per visit for 62–100 miles (Carmel, Monterey, Pebble Beach, Pacific Grove, Hollister, Sausalito, Mill Valley, Napa); the fee also applies to package visits. Minimum session 90 minutes.
- $300 / 90 min, $400 / 120 min (minimum 90 minutes, 24-hour advance booking)
- Post-op lymphatic drainage at home: $400 / 90 min, $600 / 120 min
- Mother & Baby Bonding Package at home: $400 / 120 min
- Core service area (travel included): Mountain View, Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Cupertino, San Jose, Campbell, Saratoga, Milpitas, Fremont, Menlo Park, Atherton, Woodside, Redwood City, San Mateo, Foster City, Los Gatos, Morgan Hill, San Francisco, Santa Cruz
- Mobile packages (15 or 20 visits; travel included within about 37 miles, +$50 / +$80 per therapist per visit in extended areas): 90 min $285 / $265 per visit; 120 min $380 / $350 per visit

## In-home programs (9, each has its own page)

All delivered at the client's home, hotel or office; travel included within about 37 miles of Mountain View (+$50 / +$80 per therapist per visit in extended areas within about 2 hours). Packages are 15 or 20 visits.

1. [Post-Op Recovery at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/in-home-post-op-recovery.html): post-surgical manual lymphatic drainage after liposuction, Lipo 360, BBL, tummy tuck, breast and facial surgery, C-section. Physician clearance required. 90 min $400, 120 min $600; 15 visits $380/$570 each; 20 visits $350/$525 each.
2. [Mother & Baby Bonding at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/in-home-mother-baby-massage.html): 120 min — 90 min postpartum massage or lymphatic drainage for mom + 30 min therapist-guided infant massage. $400 per visit; 15 visits $380 each; 20 visits $350 each ($300 in studio).
3. [Corporate Chair Massage](https://hyflowmassage.com/corporate-chair-massage.html): on-site 15-minute chair massage at offices and events, $150 per therapist hour with a 4-hour minimum per booking ($600, about 14–16 employees); 20 employees take about 5.5 hours (~$825).
4. [Tech Professional Reset](https://hyflowmassage.com/in-home-tech-professional-massage.html): deep tissue and therapeutic massage for tech neck, shoulder, low-back and wrist strain from desk work. 90 min $300, 120 min $400; 15 visits $285/$380; 20 visits $265/$350.
5. [Couples Massage at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/couples-massage-at-home.html): two therapists working side by side. For two people: 90 min $600, 120 min $800; 15 visits $570/$760; 20 visits $525/$700.
6. [Senior Gentle Care at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/in-home-senior-massage.html): gentle massage for older adults on a table, recliner or chair; family welcome. 90 min $300, 120 min $400; 15 visits $285/$380; 20 visits $265/$350.
7. [Hotel & Jet-Lag Recovery](https://hyflowmassage.com/hotel-massage-jet-lag-recovery.html): in-room hotel massage for travelers — lymphatic drainage for flight swelling, deep tissue or Swedish. 90 min $300, 120 min $400.
8. [VIP Wellness Ritual at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/vip-wellness-ritual-at-home.html): in-home only, created by Tina Zhang and delivered by Tina or her team — guided Tai Chi breathing and movement + manual lymphatic drainage + neck and shoulder release. 120 min $500 (15 visits $475, 20 visits $440 each); 150 min $600 ($570 / $525). Couples VIP with two therapists: 120 min $950 ($900 / $830); 150 min $1,150 ($1,090 / $1,000).
9. [Cancer Recovery Care at Home](https://hyflowmassage.com/in-home-cancer-recovery-care.html): in-home only, 2 hours — gentle Tai Chi breathing and movement (about 30 min) + light manual lymphatic drainage and relaxation massage (about 90 min) for adults during or after cancer treatment. Supportive comfort care, not cancer or lymphedema treatment; written oncologist/physician clearance required. $500 per session; 15 sessions $475 each; 20 sessions $440 each.

## Corporate pricing (the only corporate rates)

All corporate programs use one rate: $150 per therapist hour with a 4-hour minimum per booking ($600, about 14–16 employees at 15 minutes each); 20 employees take about 5.5 hours, roughly $825. No travel fee within about 37 miles of Mountain View (including San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Palo Alto, Cupertino).
- Price per visit by team size ($150 per therapist hour, 4-hour minimum per therapist; book online): 1 therapist 4/5/6/7 hrs = $600 / $750 / $900 / $1,050; 2 therapists = $1,200 / $1,500 / $1,800 / $2,100; 3 therapists = $1,800 / $2,250 / $2,700 / $3,150. More than 3 therapists: text (408) 668-6562.
- Single events: Half-Day Event, 4 hrs (minimum), up to 16 employees, $600; Full-Day Event, 6 hrs chair + table, up to 24 employees, $900; Premium Team Event, 2 therapists × 6 hrs, up to 48 employees, $1,800
- Recurring programs: each visit 4–7 hours ($600–$1,050 per visit at $150 per therapist hour), 15–30 minutes per employee (4 hours ≈ 14–16 employees at 15 min or 7–8 at 30 min; 7 hours ≈ 26–28 at 15 min or 13–14 at 30 min). 1× a month (12 visits/yr): $600–$1,050/month, $7,200–$12,600/year; 2× a month (24): $1,200–$2,100/month, $14,400–$25,200/year; 1× a week (52): $2,600–$4,550/month, $31,200–$54,600/year; 2× a week (104): $5,200–$9,100/month, $62,400–$109,200/year; 3× a week (156): $7,800–$13,650/month, $93,600–$163,800/year. Monthly = yearly ÷ 12.
- Summary: single events from $600; monthly visits from $600/month; weekly visits from $2,600/month; annual from $7,200/year
- Vendor onboarding: certificate of insurance (COI) and vendor setup forms on request; invoices issued to the company; payment by corporate card or ACH; Net-30 terms available
- Request a quote: online form at https://hyflowmassage.com/services-corporate.html#inquiry, phone/text (408) 668-6562, or booking@hyflowmassage.com
- Important: gift card amounts are NOT corporate prices.

## Corporate chair massage programs

All use $150 per therapist hour, 4-hour minimum per therapist; 1–3 therapists bookable online (more by text).

- [Monthly & Weekly Office Visits](https://hyflowmassage.com/corporate-recurring-office-massage.html): monthly ($600–$2,100/month) or weekly ($2,600–$13,650/month) on-site chair massage; invoices, Net-30
- [Large Events · 2–3 Therapists](https://hyflowmassage.com/corporate-large-event-chair-massage.html): 2 therapists $1,200–$2,100 or 3 therapists $1,800–$3,150 for 4–7 hours (about 28–84 employees); more than 3 therapists by text
- [Tech Companies & Startups](https://hyflowmassage.com/chair-massage-tech-companies.html): chair massage for Silicon Valley tech companies and startups (tech neck, launch weeks, recurring wellness days)
- [Hospitals & Healthcare Teams](https://hyflowmassage.com/chair-massage-hospitals-healthcare.html): chair massage for hospital, clinic and nursing staff (Nurses Week May 6–12, shift-friendly, vendor credentialing on request)
- [Law, Accounting & Finance](https://hyflowmassage.com/chair-massage-law-accounting-finance.html): chair massage for law firms, CPA/accounting and finance teams (tax season, quarter-end, trial prep)
- [Airlines, Airports & Hotels](https://hyflowmassage.com/chair-massage-airlines-airports-hotels.html): chair massage for airline offices, crew bases, airport-area businesses and hotel staff near SFO and SJC (not inside airport secure areas)
- [Schools & Universities](https://hyflowmassage.com/chair-massage-schools-universities.html): chair massage for teachers, schools, districts, PTAs and universities (Teacher Appreciation Week in early May)
- [Events & Occasions](https://hyflowmassage.com/corporate-chair-massage-events.html): chair massage for employee appreciation, holiday parties, wellness weeks, health fairs, conferences, offsites and busy seasons
